newsitem.title: USA: K-Tel Int'l Q2 net up after settlement.
newsitem.headline: K-Tel Int'l Q2 net up after settlement.

text.p: K-Tel International Inc said Monday its strong earnings gain in the second quarter ended December 31 was helped by the settlement of a legal dispute with Tring International Group Plc.

The company reported net income of $1.8 million, or $0.52 a share, compared to a loss of $82,000, or $0.02 a share, one year ago. Revenues in the period were $17.1 million, down from $18.8 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
K-Tel said the settlement with Tring added $850,000, or $0.22 a share, to its second-quarter earnings in 1996.
K-Tel markets and distributes music and video entertainment products.
Trading in K-Tel shares were halted Monday afternoon at 7-3/4 pending an announcement.
